newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks turn higher before weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks turn higher before weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks, which eased at the outset, gained later on short-covering on Thursday, ahead of the Friday and Saturday weekend, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 1.32 points, or 0.10 percent, to 1,354.66 amid 59 losers and 33 gainers in the first 45 minutes of trade.
The index dipped slightly on jobbers' profit-taking after Wednesday rises in stock prices but went up later on short-covering, dealer Ali Raza said.
HUBCO rose 0.15 to 32 and Millat Tractors 2.00 to 47. Dewan Salman fell 0.25 rupee to 32.55. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
